answer_1.quote: ...We use an encoder-decoder architecture for the task of generating questions given the paragraph as context ... we employ BART as our under-lying language model...
answer_1.outputs: Generated long-form questions for each paragraph

answer_2.quote: ...We report the BLEU and ROUGE scores that are standard metrics ... We also report the answerability score by feeding the generated question and input para to the classifier we trained...

answer_4.quote: ...We conducted a small human evaluation involving 8 participants ... They were asked to play around with a web demo ... and then they filled a questionnaire about their experience...
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated various aspects such as frequency of encountering long documents, satisfaction with default reading experience, usefulness of persona selection, relevance of jumping to relevant parts, and utility of presented questions.
